decisions.reason: As an award-winning stollen that is very close to the firm's established confectionery know-how and remained visible in 2024, it fits the firm's existing knowledge base and shows clear market validation, so management would be very unlikely to withdraw it.

This bread builds directly on the firm's core baking capabilities and stayed on its own page through 2024, so despite some uncertainty from turnover among other new bread variants, management would more likely retain and refine it than drop it.

Marzipan Christmas stollen is closely related to the firm's traditional seasonal offer and remained prominently marketed in 2024, so the firm can readily leverage its existing knowledge and is likely to keep it on the market.
